items.a: LetsHyre is an AI hiring platform for experienced professionals. Candidates are verified through AI resume analysis, role-based AI interviews and skill scorecards, and employers find them through AI matching.
Employers and HR teams hiring experienced people, and experienced professionals, including those serving a notice period, who want more than a resume to speak for them.

items.q: What does an employer get when they unlock a candidate?
items.a: The resume, contact details, documents, the AI skill scorecard and the full AI interview recording. You then contact the candidate and continue hiring outside LetsHyre.

Each candidate takes role-based AI interviews, and every interview produces a skill scorecard. LetsHyre combines it with the resume analysis to show a LetsHyre score, job match and skill match for each role.

items.q: How many interviews can a candidate take?
items.a: Up to three, for three different roles or more than one attempt at the same role.
So employers see people who are actively looking. A profile stays in the talent pool for 90 days after the interview.

items.q: Does LetsHyre cost anything for professionals?
items.a: No. LetsHyre is free for professionals. Employers pay with credits only when they unlock a candidate.
LetsHyre is in early access and new features are being added. If something you need isn't there yet, contact us and tell us what you need.
